title: Hanford ETF treats 7.25 million gallons in a six-month campaign
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE reports that the Effluent Treatment Facility processed more than 7.25 million gallons of contaminated wastewater over six months and lowered one storage-basin level by almost 17 feet. Denominator: One six-month ETF campaign, measured as treated wastewater volume and the separate level change in one named storage basin.
key_findings: Finding: DOE reports that the Effluent Treatment Facility processed more than 7.25 million gallons of contaminated wastewater over six months and lowered one storage-basin level by almost 17 feet.
